The Philippines declared a national energy emergency in March, with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. invoking executive power as worker strikes paralyzed Manila and other cities. In Bangladesh, fuel shortages forced garment factories, which generate roughly 84 percent of the country’s exports, to operate at 50 to 60 percent of capacity. In Kenya, protests against fuel prices led to the deaths of four people and injured dozens of others in mid-May.
